summary: Comprehensive architectural and feature implementation plan for the 7th Atrium vertical: Freelancers & Solo Practitioners (freelance_solo / FacilityType 16). Details the complete multi-discipline freelance workspace covering client CRM, deliverables Kanban, live floating stopwatch with Pomodoro, 1-click invoice generation from unbilled time, multi-currency retainers (DZD, EUR, USD), tax reserves, scope creep alerts, and proposal-to-project conversions.
